lines.label: sc01-gate-trampoline
lines.text: First rule of the garden: the gate is a trampoline. Got it.

lines.label: sc02-unstacked
lines.text: You stacked those. Who unstacked those?

lines.label: sc03-by-supper
lines.text: You want to catch it. ...By supper. Sure. Why not.

lines.label: sc04-every-night
lines.text: ...Hi. You kept the garden all night, didn't you. Every night.

lines.label: sc05-successful-hat
lines.text: It's a successful hat, Gabu. It's a successful hat.
